user.title: Sign in to Sub-Zero
user.description: Use the email and password for your Sub-Zero Group Owner account. Your password is used to sign in and is not saved.

device.title: Select appliances
device.description: Choose the appliances to include in Home Assistant. You can change this selection later using Configure.

error.invalid_auth: Sub-Zero did not accept the sign-in details, or the session expired. Start setup again if needed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Sub-Zero or read the appliance. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Sub-Zero asked us to slow down. Wait before trying again.
error.verification_required: This account requires an additional verification step that this release does not yet support.

abort.already_configured: This account is already configured. Open Configure on its existing Sub-Zero entry to add appliances.
abort.all_configured: These appliances are already managed by another Sub-Zero entry.
abort.no_appliances: No connected appliances were found on this account.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original Sub-Zero account.

init.title: Choose appliances
init.description: The list is refreshed from your Sub-Zero account. Deselecting an appliance removes its Home Assistant device and entities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not refresh the appliance list. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Sub-Zero asked us to slow down. Wait before trying again.

abort.reauth_required: Sign in again using Home Assistant's Sub-Zero sign-in prompt, then reopen Configure.
abort.all_configured: These appliances are already managed by another Sub-Zero entry. Reopen Configure to refresh the list.
